title: Shocking Truth About Indian Food
description:
From street-side golgappas to packaged snacks, India’s food system is turning toxic - literally. Roadside stalls use contaminated water, cheap oils, and unhygienic ingredients, while big brands quietly sell adulterated products filled with chemicals, colors, and preservatives.

Every day, we eat food that looks tasty but hides dangerous levels of bacteria, pesticides, and additives. With weak regulation, corrupt inspectors, and zero accountability, the system rewards profit over public health.

In this video, we expose how unsafe food is silently making India sickand why no one is cleaning up the mess.
